output.reason: The brief ties the drop to the floor 6-8 chiller outage using the timing, the floor split and the verbatim comments, and it answers both of the VP's questions, on Orrin and the kiosks, with evidence. It is also honest that the rate-rise effect on value scores can't yet be separated from the usual August dip. Its one weakness is that it doesn't put a date or a numeric trigger on watching the value scores.
